title: CreatePendingConnectorRequest
description: POST /api/connectors/pending (HEL-955 design.md D9/task 5.1) -- creates (or re-mints onto, per D9) a pending Connector for a credentialed host. Never carries a credential value: authType/apiKeyName/apiKeyPlacement are the intended auth SHAPE only, part of the D9 re-mint match key. The actual secret arrives later, out-of-band, through the completion endpoint.

authType.description: e.g. "bearer" or "api_key" -- never "none" (a no-auth Connector is created complete via POST /api/connectors instead).

apiKeyName.description: Header or query parameter NAME the api_key credential will be attached under -- present only when authType = "api_key". Never the credential value itself.
